features.title: Game Features
features.subtitle: Unique systems that set this game apart
features.openWorldDesc: Explore vast fantasy landscapes filled with mysterious dungeons and epic bosses
features.openWorldDetail: Eternal Tower Saga features an expansive fantasy world with over 50 maps, from lush green plains to frozen mountain peaks, underground dungeons hiding countless secrets, and floating cities full of wonders. Every corner has stories to discover, living NPCs, and formidable bosses waiting to challenge you.
features.realTimePvPDesc: Battle real players in real-time arenas and prove your skills
features.realTimePvPDetail: A balanced PvP system supporting 1v1 Arena, 3v3 Team Battle, and epic Guild Wars. Ranked ladder system with seasonal rewards. Every fight demands both strategy and skill, not just raw attack power.
features.guildSystemDesc: Build guilds, rally allies, and conquer guild bosses for exclusive rewards
features.guildSystemDetail: Build your own guild with member management, ranks, and permissions. Take on guild bosses requiring full party cooperation. Construct and upgrade guild buildings, and compete in Guild Wars against other guilds to claim the top rank.
features.petSystemDesc: Collect and upgrade rare pets that boost your power
features.petSystemDetail: Over 100 pets to collect, from baby dragons to legendary unicorns. Each has unique skills, can evolve, change colors, and boost combat power. Take your pets on adventures and have them collect items in dungeons.
features.craftSystemDesc: Forge legendary weapons and armor from materials found in dungeons
features.craftSystemDetail: A deep crafting system — gather materials from monsters and dungeons, combine them to forge legendary weapons and armor. Socket gems for power boosts, engrave magic runes, and add enchantments to create truly unique items.
features.towerClimbDesc: Conquer the Eternal Tower, challenging every floor for ultimate rewards
features.towerClimbDetail: The Eternal Tower — the game's core content with 999 floors to conquer. Higher floors mean harder challenges but better rewards. Unique floor bosses, global Leaderboard rankings, and weekly rotating tower-exclusive events.

highlight.title: Highlights
highlight.subtitle: What makes Eternal Tower Saga different
highlight.graphicsDesc: Stunning K-Fantasy graphics crafted with attention to every detail
highlight.graphicsDetail: Vibrant K-Fantasy art style with unique charm, designed by Korean artists. Characters with high detail, smooth animations, spectacular skill effects. Every scene features realistic lighting and shadows, with a Day/Night cycle that transforms the game world's atmosphere.
highlight.crossPlatformDesc: Play on iOS, Android, and PC with a single account
highlight.crossPlatformDetail: Play anytime, anywhere with full Cross-Platform support. Dungeon raid with friends on PC at home, then switch to mobile for dailies when you're out. Real-time data sync with no platform limitations. Supports iOS, Android, PC, and Mac.
highlight.freeToPlayDesc: Access all main story content and game systems without paying
highlight.freeToPlayDetail: Eternal Tower Saga is 100% free to play. Every player can access the main storyline, all dungeons, and all game systems without spending a penny. Shop items are cosmetic only — no Pay-to-Win. Everyone competes on skill alone.
